items.title: U.S. Steel Stocks Nucor, Steel Dynamics: Big Winners As Canada Trade Talks Collapse?
items.summary: Nucor, Steel Dynamics, Cleveland-Cliffs and Century Aluminum could be winners from U.S.-Canada trade talks breaking down.  Last week those stocks tumbled on the prospect of a Canada trade deal that would lower U.S. tariffs on steel and aluminum.  New 50% tariffs on a $20 billion worth of Canadian goods, including liquor, electrical equipment and hockey gear, took effect on Saturday.

items.title: Which Steel Stock Has Dominated in 2026: Nucor, Steel Dynamics, or Worthington Steel?
items.summary: Three steel stocks sat in the same industry through the same cycle in 2026, yet their returns look nothing alike. One name left its shareholders with almost nothing while another ran away from the pack, and the reason comes down to something most investors overlook when picking inside a sector.

items.title: NUE, STLD, CENX, CLF Stocks Slide — Trump Reportedly Set To Halve Import Tariffs On Canadian Steel And Aluminum
items.summary: The U.S. and Canada are reportedly nearing a tentative trade deal that would lower tariffs on certain Canadian steel and aluminum exports from 50% to 25%.
